content.text: If you're a creator in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or Pakistan, you're likely familiar with the pain of waiting for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to payments]] from platforms like Gumroad or the frustration of being shut out by [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-6|Stripe Alternatives]]. In these markets, payment delays and outright rejections are common, and the costs of USDT settlements can be crippling. This guide shows you how to set up a robust infrastructure using NOWPayments webhooks with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-every-detail-2|cloudflare]] Workers, one that lets you receive crypto payments for your digital products and keep your business running smoothly, even when platforms fail.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to a reliable payment infrastructure is control and ownership. By using NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you get to decide how payments are processed, when they're sent to your wallet, and how they're converted into local currencies. This means you can avoid the delays and restrictions imposed by platforms like Gumroad, and instead, enjoy fast, reliable, and low-cost transactions. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a complete solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all deployed in 48 hours, and tested before handoff. With this stack, you can process 5 products, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and enjoy 30-day support. If you're looking for a more affordable option, you can start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), which includes the core components of the Edge Commerce Stack, but with fewer features.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, you'll need a few things: a Cloudflare account, a NOWPayments account, and a GitHub account. You'll also need to create a new GitHub repository for your project and install the necessary dependencies, including Cloudflare Workers and the NOWPayments SDK. Additionally, you'll need to configure your payment and delivery pipeline, which includes setting up your payment methods, defining your conversion rates, and configuring your delivery settings. Don't worry if this sounds overwhelming – we'll walk you through each step in detail.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and delivery pipeline is the heart of your infrastructure. This is where you define how payments are processed, when they're sent to your wallet, and how they're converted into local currencies. To set up your pipeline, you'll need to create a new payment method, define your conversion rates, and configure your delivery settings. You'll also need to set up your payment notifications, which will alert you when a payment is received, and when it's been successfully processed. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you get to control every step of the process, so you can customize your pipeline to meet your specific needs.
Use NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers to create a robust payment infrastructure that lets you control and own your payments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live. This involves deploying your Cloudflare Workers and configuring your NOWPayments account. You'll also need to test your infrastructure to ensure that it's working as expected. To process your first transaction, you'll need to create a new payment, send it to your customer, and then wait for the payment to be received and processed. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you can process transactions in seconds, and receive payments in your local currency, without the need for intermediaries like PayPal or Stripe.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running smoothly, it's time to scale. This involves increasing the number of products you're selling, adding new payment methods, and configuring your delivery settings to meet the demands of your growing business. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you can scale your business quickly and easily, without the need for expensive infrastructure or complicated setup processes.
